rationale.conceptual: The method involves custom condensed-matter theory: constructing a tight-binding Hamiltonian for pyrochlore iridate films with indirect/direct hopping and spin-orbit coupling, restricting to the j=1/2 manifold, performing self-consistent Hartree-Fock mean-field, and computing topological invariants (Chern number, Z2) from the resulting band structures. This requires genuine understanding of multi-orbital mean-field theory and topological band theory, and entails several interacting components with non-trivial math, though the overall approach is documented in the paper.
rationale.execution: The pipeline consists of three sequential steps: (1) build model and solver (not scored), (2) compute TKT trilayer phase diagram (scored CSV), (3) compute bilayer phase diagram (scored CSV). All steps use standard Python libraries (numpy, scipy) with straightforward I/O. There are no complex tooling orchestrations or data-fetch tasks.
